## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per pull request
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the new behaviour
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test
- [ ] Documentation updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] Public API, flags, and configuration documented
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader behaviour verified (UI changes only)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or customer data in the diff
- [ ] Third-party Actions pinned to a commit SHA (CI changes only)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
